reviews.text: I would like to leave a very positive review of this clinic. First and foremost, I sincerely thank Dr. Marion and his wife, as well as the assistants, for the kindness shown to my little cat, Lily. You won't be disappointed with this veterinary clinic. Kindness, professionalism, responsiveness, warmth—words fail me to describe how highly I regard this team. My little cat, Lily, passed away on Wednesday, February 27, 2019, from severe kidney failure, but she was cared for with love. Thank you for allowing me to keep her for another five years, because if I had stayed with the other veterinarian, she would have passed away long ago. A huge thank you to you all. I would recommend your clinic without hesitation.

0/5!!! I took my cat to the vet because I noticed a problem with his hindquarters. He told me it was a testicular issue and prescribed medication. Trusting him, I followed his recommendations, but things didn't improve. So I went to another vet who immediately told me he had a fractured tail and that if it had been noticed sooner, they might have been able to do something, but at that point, the only solution was to amputate his tail. Because of the vet's incompetence, lack of consideration, and the fact that he didn't even take the time to properly examine my cat, he ended up with an amputated tail. I advise you to seek out vets who genuinely care about your animals' health, not those who just want to rush through consultations and sell medications by inventing problems that don't exist while ignoring the real issues. Trusting him cost me precious time that could have been spent healing my cat. Unfortunately, I'm neither a veterinarian nor a cat specialist, so I can't tell the difference between what's true and what's false. We tend to have blind faith in veterinarians, who are supposed to be experts in the field. It was a huge mistake on my part; I don't recommend him!

I called the clinic in an emergency because my cat had a problem, and they saw me two hours later. Gentleness, kindness, and honesty are the words that come to mind to describe this veterinarian! Thank you for my cat and for your professionalism, which is rare among your colleagues!
A veterinarian who listens and is available for emergencies.
